categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes outbound peer management in net.cpp and net_processing.cpp to replace non-tx-relaying peers.
categories.rationale: Prevents outbound full-relay slots from being consumed by non-tx-relaying peers, preserving network transaction broadcast and propagation topology. The PR description notes this degrades transaction propagation without operator knowledge, addressing longstanding issues #16418 and #28371.
